data.body:
[P2] Coordinate clock advancement across runners

Registered durable invokes create separate orchestrators, but every runner receives the same static `fakeClock`. These idleness checks and pending deadlines cover only this orchestrator. A parent's three-hour wait can therefore advance the clock past an invoked child's queued one-hour continuation. The child's next one-hour wait then starts at hour three and ends at hour four, extending a workflow that should finish at hour three. Coordinate deadlines and runnable invocations across all orchestrators sharing the clock, and add coverage combining a parent wait with an invoked function's sequential waits.
